cold_email.subject: Interest in Full Time Educator / Southdale Center — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear lululemon Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Full Time Educator / Southdale Center opportunity with lululemon at lululemon.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Research Associate I/II I-O — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear SystImmune Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Research Associate I/II I-O opportunity with SystImmune at SystImmune.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in QA Lab Tech NJ — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Rockline Industries, people who make it right Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the QA Lab Tech NJ opportunity with Rockline Industries, people who make it right at Rockline Industries, people who make it right.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Weights and Research Coordinator — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear R+L Carriers Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Weights and Research Coordinator opportunity with R+L Carriers at R+L Carriers.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Instructional Assistant (Data Analytics) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Per Scholas Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Instructional Assistant (Data Analytics) opportunity with Per Scholas at Per Scholas.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Post Doctoral Fellow - Parvez Lab — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Northwestern University Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Post Doctoral Fellow - Parvez Lab opportunity with Northwestern University at Northwestern University.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Medicaid Research Associate — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Mathematica Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Medicaid Research Associate opportunity with Mathematica at Mathematica.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Post Doctoral Research Fellow — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Hospital for Special Surgery Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Post Doctoral Research Fellow opportunity with Hospital for Special Surgery at Hospital for Special Surgery.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Services Representative opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Client Service Representative — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Representative opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Representative opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

cold_email.subject: Interest in Clinical Research Associate I - St. Jude LIFE Study — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear St. Jude Children's Research Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Clinical Research Associate I - St. Jude LIFE Study opportunity with St. Jude Children's Research Hospital at St. Jude Children's Research Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Assistant School Secretary - Behavior Office — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Kalamazoo Public Schools Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Assistant School Secretary - Behavior Office opportunity with Kalamazoo Public Schools at Kalamazoo Public Schools.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Leave of Absence Specialist — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Hudson Hospital & Clinic Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Leave of Absence Specialist opportunity with Hudson Hospital & Clinic at Hudson Hospital & Clinic.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Leave of Absence Specialist — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amery Hospital & Clinic Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Leave of Absence Specialist opportunity with Amery Hospital & Clinic at Amery Hospital & Clinic.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Client Service Coordinator - 2160 — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Coordinator - 2160 opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Associate Scientist
jobs.location: United States - New York - Pearl River
jobs.description: Use Your Power for Purpose At Pfizer, our purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that transform patients' lives. Central to this mission is our Research and Development team, which strives to convert advanced science and cutting-edge technologies into impactful therapies and vaccines. Whether you are engaged in discovery sciences, ensuring drug safety and efficacy, or supporting clinical trials, your role is crucial. You will leverage innovative design and process development capabilities to expedite the delivery of top tier medicines to patients globally. By integrating advanced scientific knowledge with practical applications, we aim to bring the most effective treatments to those in need, fulfilling our commitment to improving health outcomes worldwide. What Will Be Achieved The Associate Scientist in the Clinical Immunology & Diagnostics, Robotics & Automation group supports Pfizer's vaccine research portfolio through the execution of automated sample preparation workflows. The role utilizes advanced laboratory automation systems to generate high-quality assay-ready materials, while ensuring high standards of compliance and operational excellence. How It Will Be Achieved Operate, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain laboratory automation systems to ensure reliable, compliant, and efficient laboratory operations. Follow approved procedures, safety requirements, and quality standards while seeking guidance as appropriate to ensure successful execution of assigned responsibilities. Execute assigned work and responsibilities to meet schedule demands, project milestones, and operational deadlines while maintaining a high standard of quality. Support the management of laboratory materials, reagents, controls, reference standards, and consumables required for automated workflows. Collaborate effectively with scientific, operational, and quality partners to support laboratory objectives and project deliverables. Maintain current departmental, quality and safety training requirements. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a related scientific field. Experience working in a laboratory, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or academic environment. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic laboratory systems. Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving and enhance productivity. Demonstrated curiosity for exploring how these tools can improve outcomes and understanding of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with laboratory automation, robotic liquid handling platforms (e.g., Hamilton, Tecan, Beckman Coulter), and high-throughput sample preparation workflows. Knowledge of regulated laboratory practices, data integrity principles, and quality systems (e.g., GxP). Familiarity with common AI-enabled tools to support problem solving and enhance productivity. PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS This position requires significant time in a laboratory environment and the ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE). Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and perform activities such as standing, walking, bending, reaching, and sitting for extended periods while working at laboratory workstations, automation platforms, and computer workstations. Ability to analyze data and apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to support laboratory operations and process improvements. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS This position involves a non-standard work schedule, working Sunday through Thursday. A scheduled workday would consist of a total of 8.5 hours, between 10:00 a.m. and 9:00 p.m., according to business need. This schedule will be evaluated on a monthly basis. Other Job Details: Work Location Assignment: On Premise Last Day To apply: November 11th The annual base salary for this position ranges from $60,200.00 to $100,400.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 7.5% of the base salary. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility. Candidates must be authorized to be employed in the U.S. by any employer. U.S. work visa sponsorship (such as TN, O-1, H-1B, etc.) is not available for this role now or in the future. Sunshine Act Pfizer reports payments and other transfers of value to health care providers as required by federal and state transparency laws and implementing regulations. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative. Pfizer also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. Pfizer is an E-Verify employer. This position requires permanent work authorization in the United States. Pfizer endeavors to make www.pfizer.com/careers accessible to all users. cold_email.subject: Interest in Associate Scientist — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Associate Scientist opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Youth Development Officer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear NEOGOV Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Youth Development Officer opportunity with NEOGOV at NEOGOV.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Coordinator - 002147 opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Client Service Coordinator - 000637 — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Coordinator - 000637 opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Client Service Coordinator - 005032 — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Coordinator - 005032 opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Production Supervisor
jobs.description: Use Your Power for Purpose Our breakthroughs would not reach the hands of patients without our dedicated pharmaceutical manufacturing team. We rely on agile members who understand the critical impact of their role in Pfizer’s mission. Patients need colleagues like you who take pride in their work and continuously strive to improve outcomes. Your efforts ensure that patients and physicians have timely access to the medicines they need. Role Summary Under the general guidance of the Department Manager/Lead the Operations Supervisor, in conjunction with their peers, will serves as the first line manager within the operational areas of the site. They will direct multi-shift work activities of hourly colleague in an assigned operational area of the site to include the filling, inspection, packaging, assembly and storage of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), parenteral liquid drug products and auto-injector medical devices. They will be responsible for supervising both manual and automated processes within and/or outside aseptic environments. Role Responsibilities Supervise colleague work activities in the production of [APIs, or biotechnology products or Drug Products] in compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) as well as all federal, state, and local environmental and safety regulations. Actively engage in colleague development, including timely performance feedback/appraisals as well as through other aspects of the performance management process (i.e. 1:1s, IDPs). Ensure colleague training is maintained and in compliance with appropriate procedures, specifications and standards. Assist in ensuring units are manufactured to forecasted volume with the appropriate resources. Schedules staffing, optimizing labor available to meet required product demands of customers within budgeted guidelines, communicating with and recommending actions to leadership as needed. Collaborates cross-functionally with Quality, Maintenance, Warehouse and other production personnel to ensure information is properly shared and production remains on schedule. Completes operational quality, environmental, and safety incident investigations as required. Actively partners with others, sharing knowledge, problem solving, and implementing solutions to issues on the manufacturing floor. Identifies process improvements and supports continuous improvement initiatives related to compliance, safety and production to minimize risk, ensure product quality and reduce waste through the application of OpEx and IMEx principles.Anticipates and reacts to shortages of material, equipment, personnel, and space to meet schedule and maintain inventory. Reviews batch records, supports release of production lots and ensures product meets quality and quantity standards. Maintains and improves labor standards as it relates to having the proper number of colleagues assigned to each line per the line standards to meet staffing and financial guidelines. Champions a safety culture by aiding in the establishment of safety rules and instruction. Adheres to safety requirements. Reports events to EH&S. Ensures events are contained and appropriate steps are taken to mitigate risk to product and the manufacturing environment. Provides continuous GMP coaching (i.e. aseptic practices, GDP, visual inspection sequence adherence, etc.) to ensure procedures and policies are followed and ensure the quality of the product. Assists manager with special projects and other duties as assigned or needed. Minimum Requirements (Here's What You Need) Education and prior pharmaceutical and/or manufacturing experience required for this role. Prior experience includes strong knowledge, support and capability related to manufacturing operations, methods and practices. Qualifying military experience may also be considered in lieu of industrial experience. Specifics as follows: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or Science with a minimum of 2+ years of experience and 1+ years demonstrated leadership capability in a pharmaceutical and/or manufacturing environment), OR an Associates Degree with a minimum of 6+ years of experience and 3+ years demonstrated leadership capability in a pharmaceutical and/or manufacturing environment, OR a High School Diploma with a minimum 8+ years of experience and 5+ years demonstrated leadership capability in a pharmaceutical and/or manufacturing environment. Ability to manage, organize, problem solve and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, while exercising leadership, diplomacy, and problem-solving skills, coordinating and working with all levels of Colleagues. Able to successfully manage production per accuracy parameters, controlling damaged product while meeting customer service goals. Working knowledge and experience with SAP or equivalent inventory management software. Proficient with using Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio). Physical/Mental Requirements Ability to stand upright for several consecutive hours absent of any medical restrictions which could restrict completion of required duties. Able to stand and frequently walk between production centers/areas to supervise operations. Occasional bending, stooping, squatting, carrying and/or lifting up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust and focus. This position works around moving machines, is exposed to temperature changes and is required to wear personal protective equipment in certain areas. jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. Position Summary The Commercial Data & AI HYD team is seeking a Data & AI Platform Engineer II to help build and operate the Databricks and Unity Catalog platform infrastructure underpinning the team's data products. This role is central to ensuring the platform remains reliable, secure, and ready to support new Commercial AI initiatives. The successful candidate will manage cloud engineering tasks for the platform, coordinate with Enterprise IT on systems integration and feature enablement, and help ensure the team's platform configuration remains aligned with enterprise architecture standards. This includes supporting platform reliability and security through access controls, monitoring, and configuration management. This role offers the opportunity to build deep platform engineering expertise while working closely with both the Enterprise IT and Commercial Data & AI teams, with room to grow into more senior platform and architecture responsibilities over time. Key Responsibilities Build, configure, and operate Databricks and Unity Catalog platform components supporting the team's data products, including workspace, cluster, and access configuration. Manage cloud engineering tasks for the platform, including provisioning, cost management, and performance tuning of the underlying cloud infrastructure. Coordinate with Enterprise IT on systems integration and feature enablement, supporting rollout of new platform capabilities to the team. Partner with Enterprise IT and the team's data architects on platform architecture standards, ensuring configuration stays aligned with enterprise-wide direction. Support platform reliability and security by implementing access controls, monitoring, and configuration management for the Databricks environment. Troubleshoot platform-level issues affecting pipeline execution, working with data engineers to isolate platform versus pipeline-specific issues. Validate that newly migrated infrastructure meets performance and reliability requirements before cutover to production use. Document platform configuration, access patterns, and operational runbooks to support consistent operations across the team. Skills & Competencies Working proficiency in SQL and Python for platform automation and configuration scripting. Hands-on experience with Databricks platform administration (workspace configuration, clusters, jobs, Unity Catalog) and Delta Lake concepts. Experience with cloud infrastructure fundamentals (e.g., AWS storage, compute, networking, and IAM concepts) relevant to a Databricks deployment. Understanding of access control, security, and compliance considerations for a shared data platform handling sensitive commercial pharma data. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code or configuration management approaches for reproducible platform setup. Working knowledge of software engineering practices including Git/version control, code reviews, and CI/CD concepts. Good troubleshooting and cross-team communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both data engineers and Enterprise IT. Understanding of data governance and secure data handling practices, including access controls and protection of sensitive data. Qualifications & Experience A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 3–5 years of hands-on experience in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or data platform administration. Experience administering or operating a Databricks environment, including Unity Catalog, in a production setting. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) supporting data engineering workloads. Preferred: experience coordinating with a central Enterprise IT or platform team on integration and architecture standards. Preferred: experience working in a regulated or pharma commercial data environment. We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. How We Work Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. cold_email.subject: Interest in Data & AI Platform Engineer II, Commercialization — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Bristol Myers Squibb Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Data & AI Platform Engineer II, Commercialization opportunity with Bristol Myers Squibb at Bristol Myers Squibb.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Analytical AI Engineer - II
jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. Role Overview The Analytical AI Engineer - II builds and maintains analytical and machine learning models, dashboards, and semantic layers/knowledge graphs that turn business questions into data-driven insights, working under the guidance of senior team members. This role also applies Generative AI and LLM-based techniques to make analytics outputs and semantic assets consumable by AI Agent solutions and downstream applications. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain analytical and machine learning models for forecasting, classification, regression, anomaly detection, and other data-driven decision-making use cases, under the guidance of senior team members Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements, translate business questions into analytical tasks, and apply statistical methods to generate insights Build and maintain analytical dashboards, and contribute to semantic layer development to support consistent, reusable metrics and self-service reporting Contribute to the design and development of semantic layers, ontologies, and knowledge graphs, and help make them accessible and consumable for AI Agent solutions and downstream applications Build semantic and context layers (business definitions, metrics, entity relationships, metadata, and curated retrieval context), and consume them through Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions so AI agents and LLM applications can deliver accurate, grounded, and explainable insights Build and maintain analytics and ML pipelines — from data extraction, cleaning, and feature engineering through model development, validation, and deployment Develop and support data pipelines for analytical modeling and reporting needs Apply Generative AI and LLM-based techniques where relevant to support analytics workflows Track experiments and manage model versions using experiment-tracking tools Write clean, well-documented, production-ready code for analytical modeling and pipeline development Use AI coding assistants to accelerate development productivity Manage source code and version control, and contribute to CI/CD workflows Collaborate with team members following Agile/Scrum methodologies Desired Experience Analytics & Machine Learning Hands-on experience building forecasting , classification , regression , and anomaly detection models with libraries such as Scikit-learn , PyTorch , and TensorFlow/Keras , iterating under senior guidance from problem framing through model evaluation Comfort partnering directly with business stakeholders to turn open-ended questions into testable hypotheses, then running A/B tests and other hypothesis-testing designs in Python / SQL to quantify impact and communicate findings back in business terms Dashboards & Semantic Layer Experience building and maintaining production dashboards (e.g. in Tableau , Power BI , or Looker ) backed by a shared semantic layer, so metrics stay consistent across self-service reports rather than being redefined per dashboard Exposure to modeling semantic layers , ontologies , and knowledge graphs (e.g. with RDF , OWL , SPARQL , or Neo4j ) and structuring them so an AI Agent or downstream GenAI application can query and reason over them, not just a human reading a report Data & ML Pipelines Working experience standing up end-to-end pipelines on Databricks — extraction, cleaning, feature engineering, model training/validation, and deployment — as a single reproducible workflow rather than disconnected notebooks Practical use of PySpark to process and transform large, distributed datasets efficiently, including partitioning and join strategies that keep feature-engineering jobs performant at scale GenAI & LLM Applications Applied exposure to Generative AI and LLM -based techniques (prompting, summarization, retrieval-style workflows) to automate insight generation or summarize analytical findings for stakeholders, ideally with some familiarity with Azure OpenAI , AWS Bedrock , or Google Vertex AI Tools, Engineering Practices & Collaboration Disciplined use of MLflow (or equivalent) to log experiments, compare runs, and version models so results are reproducible and auditable by teammates Strong day-to-day Python and SQL coding habits — modular, tested, documented — suited to code that will run in production pipelines, not just exploratory notebooks Regular use of VS Code (or similar) paired with AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code to move faster without sacrificing code review quality Solid Git / GitHub workflow habits (branching, PRs, code review) and comfort contributing to CI/CD pipelines that deploy models and data jobs Experience working within Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, retros) as part of a cross-functional analytics team Good to Have Exposure to GenAI & Agentic Frameworks like LangChain , LangGraph , Pydantic AI , LlamaIndex , etc. Familiarity with LLM platforms like Azure OpenAI , AWS Bedrock , Google Vertex AI , etc. Experience with knowledge graph or ontology tools/technologies (e.g., RDF , OWL , SPARQL , Neo4j , or similar) Experience with BI/visualization tools (e.g., Tableau , Power BI , Looker ) Exposure to cloud platforms ( AWS , Azure , or GCP ) for analytics or model deployment Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field, with 3+ years of progressively responsible experience in analytics, data science, or applied AI/ML roles Solid grounding in statistics and probability, with working knowledge of experimental design Experience with Databricks for data pipeline development and analytical/ML workloads Working knowledge of PySpark for distributed data processing Familiarity with MLflow (or equivalent) for experiment tracking Experience building analytical dashboards; exposure to semantic layer concepts Experience or hands-on exposure to building semantic layers, ontologies, or knowledge graphs, and structuring them for consumption by AI Agent or GenAI-based applications Experience with core ML libraries and frameworks including Scikit-learn , NumPy , Pandas , PyTorch , TensorFlow/Keras , etc. Proficiency in SQL and experience working with structured and semi-structured datasets Strong Python programming skills for analytical modeling and pipeline development Proficiency with Git for version control We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. How We Work Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. cold_email.subject: Interest in Analytical AI Engineer - II — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Bristol Myers Squibb Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Analytical AI Engineer - II opportunity with Bristol Myers Squibb at Bristol Myers Squibb.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Partner Development Representative | Advisory and Services
jobs.description: ABOUT RAMP Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role Ramp's Advisory & Services channel is one of the most strategically important growth levers in the business. As an Advisory& Services Partner Development Representative (PDR), you'll be the engine behind acquiring, reactivating, and qualifying the consulting firms, System Integrators (SIs), and advisory practices that refer, implement, or integrate Ramp for their clients. You'll be holding conversations with partnership heads, business development leads,Managing Directors, and practice leads at consulting firms, ERP implementation shops, and strategic advisory practices - building relationships that turn into signed referral agreements and a pipeline of activated partners that are Ramp champions. jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a member of our Finance Analytics and Business Intelligence team, you'll play an instrumental role in our company's mission of building safe and beneficial AI by establishing the analytics engineering and business intelligence capabilities our Accounting organization runs on. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to ensuring accurate financial reporting, streamlining accounting processes, and supporting financial operations as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world. You'll partner closely with the Accounting organization to build the data foundation that turns financial and operational data into reliable, self-serve insight and automated processes. That means owning the data models and orchestration beneath accounting analytics, designing the dashboards and data applications stakeholders rely on day to day, and partnering across Data Engineering, Data Science, and the broader Finance organization to make sure every number is one the team can trust. Increasingly, it also means defining the future of AI-powered accounting automation; finding where AI can take on work that is manual today and reshape how the function operates. This is a foundational, hands-on role at the intersection of accounting, analytics, and business intelligence. You'll establish the durable, scalable systems the fast-growing function depends on, bringing the rigor of a culture of excellence to a function still being built from the ground up, and taking projects end to end, from an ambiguous question to a trusted, scalable system. Key responsibilities Design, build, and maintain data models and orchestration pipelines (dbt, Airflow) that power analytics, reporting, and downstream financial workflows Develop dashboards, visualizations, and data applications that give stakeholders self-serve access to their data Translate stakeholders' business questions into well-defined metrics and tools, and turn the resulting analysis into clear recommendations Build analytics that support financial reporting, the close process, reconciliations, and scenario analysis Define the future of AI-powered accounting automation in partnership with stakeholders, streamlining workflows and reducing manual effort Champion data quality, testing, and documentation across the data stack Minimum qualifications Proficiency in SQL and Python (or another object-oriented programming language) Experience with data modeling and orchestration tools (e.g., dbt and Airflow) Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Hex, Streamlit) Experience designing self-serve analytics experiences for non-technical stakeholders A track record of partnering closely with Finance or Accounting teams to drive business and financial outcomes, turning open questions and data into clear, insightful analysis Preferred qualifications Experience using AI to improve or automate analytical processes Experience building data applications Experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP) and their cost structures Experience modeling financial impact, including forecasting and scenario analysis A bias for action and urgency, not letting perfect be the enemy of effective A strong disposition to thrive in ambiguity, taking initiative to create clarity and forward progress A deep curiosity and energy for pulling the thread on hard questions A passion for Anthropic's mission of building safe, beneficial AI The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $270,000 — $345,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

cold_email.subject: Interest in Clinical Lab Scientist II — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Clinical Lab Scientist II opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Representative opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Manager, AI Ops Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: ROLE SUMMARY The CISO Infrastructure & Cloud Services organization delivers excellence in the pursuit of breakthroughs that change patients' lives through industry-leading infrastructure operations performance. We ensure optimal performance of global application hosting and network services that power Pfizer's business processes. We strive to revolutionize service dependability by applying advanced analytics to drive predictive detection, identifying potential issues with our services and intervening before they disrupt our business. We place data at the heart of what we do and apply a relentless focus on continuous improvement to enable Pfizer's business processes and patient outcomes. We are seeking an Manager, AI Ops Site Reliability Engineer to own how our operations agents think and how well they perform, within Hosting SRE Operations, based in Greece. In this role, you design the agent workflows, prompts and context, build the evaluation harness that proves accuracy against our own estate, and partner with our existing domain experts to convert their operational know-how into reliable, measurable agent behavior. You bring depth in AI and evaluation; our domain specialists bring the deep OS, Storage, Data Protection, Database and HCI knowledge - together you turn classic operations into trustworthy AI operations. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Design agent workflows for intake and investigation: the prompts, context and retrieval, tool selection and decision logic that determine how the agent classifies, enriches and reasons about incidents. Build and own the evaluation harness: ground-truth datasets drawn from historical incidents, accuracy, precision and recall metrics, regression tests, and hallucination and error detection - so every change to an agent is measured before it ships. Define the reasoning guardrails: what an agent may conclude and propose, how confident it must be, and when it must defer to a human - the quality side of the approval gate. Turn tacit operational knowledge into machine-usable context: work with the existing domain experts to convert their runbooks and past investigations into retrievable knowledge the agent can cite. Run the transformation on Operational workflows: take a classic operational process, redesign it with the domain owner as an agent-assisted flow, pilot it, and measure toil and MTTR reduction. Continuously tune agent quality against production results, feeding misses back into prompts, context and the evaluation sets. Collaborate with SRE, Ops, Platform teams, AI Ops Platform Engineers, AI Ops Site Reliability Engineers, and other stakeholders to align operational requirements, platform capabilities, automation strategies, and execution priorities QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience. 4 years+ in software, data or ML/AI engineering, including hands-on delivery of LLM or agent-based applications in production. Demonstrated prompt and context engineering, and experience building structured evaluations for AI systems (ground-truth sets, metrics, regression testing; LLM-as-judge a plus). Working knowledge of agent frameworks and tooling (for example Amazon Bedrock AgentCore or LangGraph) and RAG / knowledge-base design, with strong Python. IT operations literacy to design realistic operational workflows and judge the plausibility of agent output. You do not need to be a domain administrator - you will partner with domain experts who are. Strong analytical and communication skills to work with SREs, extract knowledge and present accuracy results credibly. Familiarity with ServiceNow, Dynatrace or observability data is a plus. Demonstrated experience in an agile work environment possessing qualities such as a collaborative mindset, adaptability to change, and a proactive problem-solving approach. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Periodic international and domestic travel required (less than 10%) Please apply by sending your CV in English.
